title: Boop
blurb: A soft, friendly two-tone boop. This is the sound of tapping someone on the nose, of a wholesome UI interaction, of small delightful things happening. Streamers use it for channel-point redemptions, editors for cute moments, and everyone else because pressing a button labeled Boop and hearing a boop is a complete experience in itself. Original synthesized audio, free to download and use.
origin: Original Bleepboard synthesis — the house boop.
